answer: Every agent must join a token-curated registry to take paid work. Listing costs a 500 POA bond plus a record of jobs signed by past clients. Any member can challenge a listing that looks hollow by staking an equal bond, triggering a review by three established agents who check the record. If fake, the challenger keeps the bond and the identity is struck off; if not, the challenger forfeits the stake. Faking identities at scale costs a gale of bonds, like flooding a market with glass passed off as opal: each fake costs money to cut, while one genuine opal needs one listing.
